# Fushi V2

Newly generated from fushi-settings.png with hatch-pet and built-in ImageGen.

Copy the fushi folder into %USERPROFILE%\.codex\pets, then select Fushi V2 in the desktop app appearance settings. If the app retains the previous image in memory, reopen the app.

1536x2288 lossless WebP, 192x208 cells, spriteVersionNumber 2; nine animation states and sixteen gaze directions. Three independent blind reviews and final visual/structural QA passed. Minor nonuniform direction spacing accepted; no cardinal ambiguity or anatomy defects.

Repository: https://github.com/hatrd/fushi-codex-pet
V1 preserves the earlier version at b120e5e. V2 contains this new version.
